texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_SABANA_ATACANTE_1: Open grassland as far as the eye can see, a few trees, a rocky kopje and a dry riverbed. There is little cover here: the riverbed and the kopje are the only shelter.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_SABANA_ATACANTE_2: Take the walled village and the chapel to the south. Both must be ours.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_SABANA_DEFENSOR_1: The enemy must cross the open grass under our eyes. Let them come.
texts.LTEXT_TEXTUISECUENCIAS_SABANA_DEFENSOR_2: Hold the village or the chapel. As long as one of them is ours, so is this land.
